comparison.objective: Hang two plates on separate moving conveyor hooks before a deadline.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception, hole-on-hook insertion, release, and settling on moving targets.
comparison.success_condition: Each plate hangs freely, plumb and settled on its own hook for the final 1 s before the mark.
comparison.reason: Dynamic hole engagement on moving hooks is different from passing many particles through a stationary screen while retaining parts.
